answer: Each identity must rent a safe deposit box in person, showing photo ID and proof of address, at about $60 a year per box. A farm needs a distinct verified renter per fake, so 1,000 fakes cost $60,000 every year plus a branch visit each. The ridge is steep: every fake adds another annual fee, the mirror of the bank's renter register exposes shared names, and the pulse of yearly renewals rises with farm size.
